string.text_gamepad: To use the binoculars, open weapon menu $$ACTION_WPN_RADIAL_MENU$$, select them and press $$ACTION_WPN_FIRE$$ to zoom in.
To crouch, press $$ACTION_crouch$$. To crouch even lower, hold $$ACTION_crouch$$.
Some stalkers won't want to talk if you stick your weapon in their face. To hide your weapon you only need to open weapon menu $$ACTION_WPN_RADIAL_MENU$$ and select a bolt.
